scenarios.swap: drift moves from factor 1 to factor 2 at the change
scenarios.ramp: drift moves linearly from factor 1 to factor 2 over 800 bars from the change
scenarios.flip: factor 1 drift changes sign at the change

evaluation.roc_definition: TPR = share of change runs with any alarm in [change, change + horizon]; FPR = share of paired control runs (same seeds) with any alarm in the same window
